Title: Hanwell Zoo (Bunny Park), Brent Lodge Park
Address: Hanwell Zoo, Brent Lodge Park, Church Road, Hanwell
DaysOfWeek: Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu, Fri, Sat, Sun
ScheduleText: Every day except Christmas Day. 12 September – 31 March 10:00–16:00 (last entry 15:00); 1 April – 11 September 10:00–17:00 (last entry 16:00)
PriceText: Child £4; under-3s and carers (with documents) free; season tickets adult £21, child £16
Description: Small zoo in Brent Lodge Park, once known as the Bunny Park, next to the Millennium maze, a playground and a café. 10 minutes' walk from Hanwell station (Elizabeth line)
Pros: Cheap, little ones free, maze and playground next door
Cons: Small free car park often full by 11:00

Title: Battersea Park Children's Zoo
Address: Battersea Park Children's Zoo, Battersea Park, London
DaysOfWeek: Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu, Fri, Sat, Sun
ScheduleText: Open daily 10:00–16:30 (last entry 16:00; hours shown for 31 Oct – 1 Nov 2026, check the calendar for winter). Daily keeper feeding talks. No booking needed
PriceText: Child (2–15) £13.95, adult £17.50, family (2+2 or 1+3) £53.95, under-2s free; tickets valid for one visit within 30 days
Description: Small family zoo with over 100 animals (monkeys, meerkats, otters, lemurs, farm animals) and adventure playgrounds with a real tractor, fire engine and helicopter, a giant climbing web and a sensory sandpit. Monthly 'Little Bookworms' book club
Pros: Made for little children; play areas inside; about an hour to go round

Title: London Zoo, Regent's Park
Address: ZSL London Zoo, Regent's Park, London
DaysOfWeek: Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu, Fri, Sat, Sun
ScheduleText: Every day except Christmas Day. 24 Oct 2026 – 12 Feb 2027: 10:00–16:00 (last entry 15:00); 13 Feb – 25 Mar 2027: 10:00–17:00; 26 Mar – 31 Aug 2027: 10:00–18:00. Relaxed early openings for autistic and neurodivergent visitors
PriceText: Under-3s free. Online before 10:00 on the day, without donation: child (3–15) £19.40 off-peak weekday to £24.10 peak, adult £27.70–£34.50 (more with the 10% voluntary donation and at the gate). Universal Credit tickets available
Description: London's big zoo in Regent's Park: lions, tigers, gorillas, penguins, giraffes and more; scooters allowed for children
Cons: Expensive; bag checks at the gate

Title: WWT London Wetland Centre, Barnes
Address: WWT London Wetland Centre, Barnes, London
DaysOfWeek: Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu, Fri, Sat, Sun
ScheduleText: Every day except Christmas Day, 10:00–16:30 (last admission 15:30); Christmas Eve 10:00–15:00
PriceText: Under-3s free. Online in advance (10% off): junior (3–17) £11.12, adult £17.10, family (2+2) £48.11 without Gift Aid (£12.25 / £18.85 / £52.95 with Gift Aid). Universal Credit tickets available
Description: Nature reserve by the Thames with ponds, hides and wetland birds and animals; café with hot lunches 11:30–15:00
Pros: Under-3s free; free car park; accessible paths

Title: SEA LIFE London Aquarium
Address: SEA LIFE London, Riverside Building, County Hall, Westminster Bridge Road, London
DaysOfWeek: Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu, Fri, Sat, Sun
ScheduleText: Open daily; hours vary (31 Oct 2026, half-term: 9:30–19:00, last entry 18:00). Timed entry when booked online

Description: Indoor aquarium over 3 floors with 500 species in 14 zones: gentoo penguins, the UK's largest jellyfish experience and living coral reef, a rockpool, a rainforest zone
